name: Gas Mask-sensei
source:
A teacher at NEVAEH Academy. He always wears a gas mask and a white coat. His hobby is doing bizarre experiments at the science lab. A self-styled sadist.

[From the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/baw/chara/]Official Site[/url]]
